test_cases.title: Single sign-on session fixation
test_cases.description: Confirm the SSO flow issues a fresh session after authentication.
test_cases.procedure: Capture the session identifier before and after completing the SSO login with a test account.
test_cases.expected_results: A new session identifier is issued once authentication completes.
test_cases.evidence_requirements: Request/response pairs showing the identifier before and after login, tokens redacted.
test_cases.validation_criteria: A tester reproduces reuse of a pre-authentication session after login.
test_cases.remediation_guidance: Regenerate the session identifier whenever the privilege level changes.

test_cases.title: Loyalty points cannot go negative
test_cases.description: Confirm the server rejects redemptions larger than the available balance.
test_cases.procedure: With a test account, attempt to redeem more points than the balance in the sandbox.
test_cases.expected_results: The redemption is refused and the balance is unchanged.
test_cases.evidence_requirements: The request and response showing the refusal, plus the unchanged balance.
test_cases.validation_criteria: A tester reproduces a redemption that should fail and confirms the balance stays correct.
test_cases.remediation_guidance: Validate balances on the server inside a transaction before applying a redemption.
